01 / About

Looking with new eyes.

Real moments, as they actually happen

At Gilman Visual Media, we believe the most powerful images are the ones that reflect real life. In a world full of heavy filters and over-processed edits, our focus is simple: deliver clean, authentic, and timeless photography that captures genuine moments as they actually happen.

We specialize in realistic, raw storytelling. Whether we are covering events, portraits, commercial work, or life’s natural milestones, our goal isn’t to reshape reality — it’s to preserve it. We keep our editing intentional and minimal, allowing natural light, true colors, and honest emotion to take center stage.

“Mystery is not about traveling to new places but about looking with new eyes.”

— Marcel Proust

What we shoot.

Photography
01Photography / Portraits & headshots

Portraits & headshots

02Photography / Events & celebrations

Events & celebrations

Hourly documentary-style coverage of corporate functions, private parties and community gatherings — true-to-life colors, an organized online gallery to share and download. Delivery in 1–2 weeks.

$150–$250 / hr
03Photography / Weddings & special milestones

Weddings & special milestones

Commercial, pet & lifestyle

from $200

Real estate photography

Crisp, well-lit interior and exterior shots that present the layout, space and detail without distorted wide angles or unnatural color shifts. Natural lighting balance, standard correction, MLS-ready delivery. Scaled by square footage.
